phrases.displayText: I spoke to the building manager about the leak
phrases.translation: Conversei com o gerente do prédio sobre o vazamento

phrases.displayText: He said the plumber would come on Thursday morning
phrases.translation: Ele disse que o encanador viria na manhã de quinta-feira

phrases.displayText: Yes. He told me the appointment was between nine and eleven
phrases.translation: Sim. Ele me disse que a consulta seria entre nove e onze horas

phrases.displayText: I’ll be at work. Did he ask us to leave a spare key?
phrases.translation: Estarei no trabalho. Ele pediu para deixarmos uma chave reserva?

phrases.displayText: He did. He asked us to leave it at reception
phrases.translation: Sim, ele fez isso. Pediu que deixássemos na recepção

phrases.displayText: Okay. I’ll do that before I leave
phrases.translation: Certo. Farei isso antes de ir embora
